Commentary.Commentary: So, can India keep the Bangla Tigers at bay or will the visitors rock the world by chasing this total down? Join us in a while to find out!
The Bangladesh bowlers had a tough night all round. Only Al-Amin Hossain and Soumya Sarkar came out with good performances. Other than them, the bowling was pretty dour.

India had a rocky start as skipper Rohit Sharma was dismissed early on. However, Dhawan and Rahul steadied the ship and started playing their strokes after a while. The main stand came between Shreyas Iyer and KL Rahul who both scored half tons and stitched a very good partnership. India stuttered at the end due to the fall of wickets but managed to end on a good total.
So, India have set a target of 175 for Bangladesh to chase down and it will not be an easy task. However, with the dew around, we cannot say anything.

Beautiful yorker to finish off by Mustafizur, Dube jams it out towards mid-wicket. The batters have nothing to lose and they scamper back. They manage to take the second because of a bad throw. INDIA FINISH ON 174/5.
Full toss on the pads of Manish Pandey, he does not make full use of it and the ball goes towards backward square leg for a single.
Almost a yorker on middle, Dube flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Excellent yorker, around leg, dug out for a quick single. The bowler slips while trying to pick the ball.
FOUR! Bad bowling and punished! A full toss, around middle, Pandey walks down the track and pulls it wide of mid-wicket for a boundary!
Full on leg, worked wide of long on for a couple.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl the last over of the innings.
Another short delivery which has been pulled away for a couple.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

DROPPED! This the second time that Aminul Islam has dropped a catch tonight. Short of a length delivery on middle, Dube pulls this one away towards mid-wicket where the fielder comes forward to take an easy catch but drops it.
Pandey this time takes the aerial route over covers but just a single.
Short delivery on the pads, Dube pulls this one towards square leg but the ball falls just short of the fielder. Single taken.
Weird that one was not called wide. Short ball down the leg side, Dube leaves this one alone. He thought that the umpire would signal wide but nothing coming.
Al-Amin to bowl the penultimate over.
Good length ball on off, Manish pulls it towards mid-wicket and gets a couple.
FOUR! This is brilliant batting! Length ball around off, Manish picks the length early. He sees that the third man is up so he just guides it past him with an upper cut for a boundary.
FOUR! Hammered away! Good length ball on off, Manish gets on his back foot and smashes his pull through mid-wicket with power for a boundary.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a length, Pandey pulls it towards long on for a single.
On the pads, Dube flicks it towareds mid-wicket for one.
Shafiul Islam to bowl out. 3-1-19-2, his figures so far.
Length ball on middle and off, Pandey tries to pull this one but misses.
Shivam Dube walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! The well-set Shreyas Iyer departs now. Full ball on off, Iyer looks to clear the long off fence this time. However, he does not time it perfectly and the ball goes to Liton Das who takes a good catch diving forward.
FOUR! What a shot by Iyer! A low full toss on middle and leg, Iyer flicks this one exactly in the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pandey pushes this one towards long on for one.
Length ball outside off, Pandey looks to cut but the ball stays low.
Manish Pandey replaces Rishabh Pant out in the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! Pant has been dismissed after another under par performance from him. Good length ball on middle and leg, Pant looks to heave this one towards the leg side but misses the ball completely as it stays low. It crashes into the middle stump and Rishabh Pant has to walk back.
Soumya Sarkar is back on.
Iyer again drives this one towards cover but straight to the man.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
FOUR! Short delivery on the leg side, Iyer pulls this one towards backward square leg for a boundary.
On the pads of Iyer, he works it just wide of short fine leg. Al-Amin there puts in a good effort there and half-stops the ball. Two runs taken.
This time Pant connects with his pull shot and the ball goes towards square leg for a single.
Wide! Way too wide this time by Fizz, Pant tries to get his bat to it but misses.
Short delivery on middle and leg, Pant tries to play the hook shot but misses.
Mustafizur Rahman comes back into the attack. 2-0-21-0, his figures so far.
On the pads of Pant, he flicks this one towards mid-wicket for one. 20 off the over.
50 up for Iyer and it has come off just 27 balls. He gets to his half ton by flicking this one towards square leg for one.
Good delivery by Hossain and much needed one. He bowls a flatter yorker outside off which beats Shreyas.
SIX! Three in a row! This is the biggest of them all! On the pads this time, Iyer smashes this one over the mid-wicket fence. Afif under the pump.
SIX! Consecutive ones! This time over the bowler's head! Floated on middle and off, Iyer this time smashes it towards the sightscreen for a maximum.
SIX! Powerfully struck! Floated on middle and off, Shreyas Iyer clears his front leg and hits it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Afif Hossain is into the attack now.
On the pads of Iyer, he flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single. 12 runs off the over.
Unorthodox by Rishabh Pant! Full ball outside off, Pant goes down on one knee and paddle scoops this one towards backward square leg for a single.
Short of a length on middle, Iyer pulls this one towards mid-wicket. Liton Das fumbles in the deep but only a single taken.
Smart batting! This time Iyer works it with soft hands towards mid-wicket for a couple.
SIX! What a shot! Flicked away! Full and on the pads, Iyer flicks this one over the mid-wicket fence with power for a biggie.
On the pads of Pant, he works it down to fine leg for a single.
Uppish but safe! On the pads of Pant, he flicks this one towards mid-wicket. The ball goes uppishly but in the gap for a single.
On off, Pant cuts this one towards point. He thinks of a single but is sent back.
On the pads of Iyer, he flicks this one off the pads towards mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On the pads of Pant, he flicks this one towards fine leg for a single to get off the mark.
Rishabh Pant is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rahul perishes after his half ton! Al-Amin Hossain bowls a good length ball on off. Rahul looks to go for the biggie by clearing the man at mid off but he mistimes it. Liton Das there takes a simple catch and Rahul looks disappointed. He walks back now but he has done a good job in setting up India for a good finish.
Al-Amin Hossain comes back into the attack. 2-0-13-0, his figures so far.
On the pads, Rahul works this one towards mid-wicket for one. 7 runs off the over.
50 up for KL Rahul and he has helped India at a crucial time here. Length ball outside off, cut towards deep point for a couple.
Length ball on middle and leg, Rahul works this one towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball on off, pushed towards cover.
Another one on the pads, this time Iyer flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads of Rahul, he flicks this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Soumya Sarkar is back on.
Floated on off, played to the point region by the batsman.

FOUR! 50-run stand up for Iyer and Rahul! Another shortish ball on middle, this time Iyer rocks back and pulls this one towards mid-wicket for a boundary. This is a very important stand for India and it has set them up for a big finish come the end of the innings.
SIX! What a shot by Iyer this! Floated on middle and off, Shreyas comes down the track and smashes this one over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Length ball on off, Rahul  tries to punch this one off the back foot but the ball goes off the bottom edge for one towards point.
FOUR! Great shot this! Shortish again on middle this time. Rahul rocks back and half-pulls it towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, Iyer pushes this one towards cover for one.
This time a length ball on off, Iyer pushes this one towards cover for one.
Shorter ball outside off, Rahul pushes this one towards cover for one.
FOUR! Rahul looking in the groove! Good length ball on off, Rahul comes down the track and lofts this one over extra cover for a boundary.
Iyer pushes this one onto the leg side and takes a quick single.
Another length ball, this time Rahul gets a leading edge on this one and the ball rolls towards point. Single taken.
FOUR! Great shot by KL Rahul this. Length ball on off, Rahul cuts this one towards point. Afif Hossain in the deep puts in a dive but cannot stop it from going for a boundary.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack.
On the pads of Rahul, he flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Iyer comes onto the front foot and defends this one onto the off side. The batters take a quick single.
Floated on off, Iyer pushes this one towards cover.
Rahul powerfully punches this one towards long off for one.
Floated on off, Rahul powerfully drives this one towards cover for a couple.
Floated on off, Rahul punches this one off the back foot towards point. There is a slight confusion between the batters for a single but eventually they opt against it.
Again on off, this time the batters get one as Rahul pushes it in the gap at cover.
Rahul punches this one off the back foot towards cover.
Another length ball on middle, Iyer pushes this one towards long on for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, pushed towards mid-wicket for a single.

Beautiful shot but just a single taken. Full ball on middle and off, Iyer drives this one down the ground. The ball goes past the bowler and Iyer wants the second but Rahul fell down before starting his first run. Single taken.
On the pads of Rahul, he glances this one towards mid-wicket for one. 50 up for India.
Soumya Sarkar replaces Shafiul Islam into the attack.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Landed around off, punched down to long on for one more.
Tossed up, around off, pushed wide of long off for a run.

FOUR! Very good shot from KL Rahul. Fractionally short outside off, Rahul rocks back and cuts it through point. The ball races away and there is Shafiul in the deep, who tries to get across to his left from sweeper, dives but the ball beats him.
The googly, around middle, worked with the turn towards wide long on for a single.
Short and outside off, slapped straight to short extra cover.
Spin time! Aminul Islam is on now.
EDGED AND FOUR! Good length ball outside off, Rahul looks to drive this one towards the off side but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a boundary.

DROPPED! What a dolly that was but Aminul Islam has dropped it! Short of a length ball outside off, Shreyas looks to cut but his one hand comes off the bat while doing so. The ball goes uppishly towards Islam at backward point but he drops an easy catch to his right. India survive a huge scare. The batsmen take a single as well.
Iyer defends his first ball of the back foot.
Length ball on middle and off, pushed towards long on for a single.
Shreyas Iyer is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Both the Indian openers have now been dismissed and India stuttering at the start. Length ball on off, Dhawan comes down the track and looks to heave this one over the mid-wicket region. Dhawan is early into his shot as this is the slower one. The ball goes high in the air towards mid-wicket. Mahmudullah, the skipper runs across from long on and sets himself under it. He makes it look comfortable in the end. Tough catch, that.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Rahul makes room and pushes this one towards cover for a single.
FOUR! Good length ball wide outside off, Dhawan stretches his arms and drives this one through the covers for the second boundary of the over. 9 runs off the over.
Good length ball on middle and off, pushed back towards the bowler.
Another length ball just outside off, Dhawan comes down the track and looks to cut this one but misses.
Bouncer on middle and off by Rahman, Dhawan sways away from it.
Length ball on middle and off, slapped towards cover but straight to the man.
FOUR! Shorter delivery on the hips of Dhawan, he slaps it over the man at square leg for a boundary. Bad start by Mustafizur.
Wide! Way outside off, Dhawan goes after it but misses.
Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack now.
Length ball outside off, Rahul cuts this one towards the man at point.
Dhawan pushes this one off the back foot towards mid on for a single.
Full ball outside off, Rahul pushes this one towards cover for a single.
This time on the pads of Rahul, he flicks this one towards backward square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Another great shot by Rahul. Looks in good touch today. Good length ball outside off, Rahul creams this one through the cover-point region.
FOUR! Gorgeous! Length ball on off, Rahul comes down the track and just punches it through mid off for a boundary.
Dhawan comes down the track but cannot do anything with this ball. Defends it out.
On the pads of Rahul, he flicks this one towards square leg and gets off the mark with a single.

Run out chance missed! That could have been disastrous for India. Full ball on off, Shikhar pushes this one towards mid off and sets off for a run. Mohammad Naim gets to the ball and goes for a direct hit towards the non-striker's end but misses by a whisker. Had he hit, Dhawan would have been out.
FOUR! Another boundary! Great counter-attacking by Dhawan! Full ball on middle and off, Dhawan lofts this one over the mid on fielder and the ball races towards the fence.
FOUR! Great shot by Dhawan. He shuffles across and flicks this one off his hips towards the mid-wicket fence.
Fuller and on off, Dhawan pushes this one towards the man at cover.
First maiden over of the series. What a start by Bangladesh! Length ball on off, pushed towards the man at cover.
Fuller on off, Rahul pushes this one towards the man at cover.
Length ball on off, Rahul pushes this one towards the man at point.
KL Rahul is the new man in for India.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! The Indian skipper departs and this is a huge blow for India. Length ball on middle and off, Rohit Sharma flicks this one towards the leg side. However, his bat comes down late and the ball goes off the inside edge onto the leg pole. How will India recover from this body blow?
Fuller on off, this time Sharma defends it out towards covers.
Length ball on off, Rohit Sharma pushes this one towards cover off the back foot.
Shafiul Islam to bowl from the other end.
Good start by Al-Amin. Just the 3 off the first over. This ball is on a good length on middle, Dhawan looks to push it out but the ball goes off the inside edge behind Dhawan.
On the pads of Rohit, he flicks this one towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
On the hips of Dhawan, he flicks this one towards backward square leg for a single. Dhawan is off the mark now.
First ball for Dhawan, it is full and off. He pushes this one towards the man at mid off.
This time it is full and outside off, Rohit superbly drives it towards cover where the fielder dives to his right and saves at least a run for his side. Single taken. Rohit is off the mark.
Good start by Al-Amin. He bowls one on a length just outside off, Rohit pushes this one towards the point fielder.

The Bangladesh players walk out onto the field for the all important clash. They are followed by the fantastic Indian duo, Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan. The Indian skipper will be taking strike. Al-Amin Hossain to start the proceedings with the ball for Bangladesh. Here we go!

INDIA (PLAYING XI) - Rohit Sharma (C), Shikhar Dhawan, KL Rahul, Shreyas Iyer, Manish Pandey (IN FOR KRUNAL PANDYA), Rishabh Pant (WK), Shivam Dube, Washington Sundar, Deepak Chahar, Yuzvendra Chahal, Khaleel Ahmed.

BANGLADESH (PLAYING XI) - Liton Das, Mohammad Naim, Soumya Sarkar, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Mohammad Mithun (IN FOR MOSADDEK HOSSAIN), Aminul Islam, Shafiul Islam, Mustafizur Rahman, Al-Amin Hossain.

Rohit Sharma, the Indian skipper, says that they would have wanted to bowl first as well but this is a very good challenge for them. He hopes that they can post a score on the board and put Bangladesh under pressure. On his 100th T20I cap, Rohit says it is another day in the office for him and nothing else. Just says that he is happy that he is playing for the nation. Informs that Manish Pandey comes in for Krunal Pandya.

Mahmudullah, the Bangladesh skipper, says that he has chosen to bowl first because the wicket looks good. Also says that India is a side that know how to chase totals down hence they have decided to bowl first. Also mentions how the dew factor might come into play late on in the game. Informs that Mosaddek Hossain is replaced in the team by Mohammad Mithun.
Toss - Heads is the call by Mahmudullah and heads it is. Bangladesh win the toss and choose to bowl first.

Pitch Report - Murali Kartik is down for the pitch report along with Sunil Gavaskar. Kartik says it is a big ground. Mr. Gavaskar suggests that there will be a bit of turn for the spinners. Further says the grass has come off a little and if the ball lands in that area, the spinners will get more purchase. Adds that the surface is crumbly and dry. Suggests that both these captains would want to chase because that has been a proven winning formula for them.

Will history be written today by Bangladesh? Or will the Men In Blue continue their dominance over the Bangla Tigers? Welcome to the third and final T20I where pride will be won and lost. After a comprehensive win in the first T20I for Bangladesh, India rocked the visitors in the second T20I as the Hitman showed his class. The visitors were annihilated by the Indian openers and India won comfortably. India will be heading into this match full of confidence and momentum. It seems that the toss will also be a very important factor in how the match pans out. Here come the pitch report and the toss.
